title: Heating and Cooling Function Chart, ComfortLease Equipment Leases
content:
Two ComfortLease Equipment Leases agreements at one address may not cover the same function: a lease that heats the home (gas furnace, heat pump, dual-fuel or ductless) cannot be signed while another heating lease is in pending installation, active or past due status, and likewise for cooling; a combination lease counts as both. A customer who has a lease in past due status cannot sign a new lease.

## Function of each leased system

| Leased system | Equipment | Function under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | gas furnace | Heating |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | heat pump with air handler | Heating |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | heat pump with gas furnace | Heating |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | ductless multi-zone heat pump | Heating |
| ComfortLease Central Air | central air conditioner | Cooling |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | gas furnace with central air conditioner | Combination — counts as heating and as cooling |

An existing lease blocks a new lease of the same function only while it is pending installation, active or past due; a lease that has been bought out or terminated blocks nothing under this rule.

## Past due leases

The second sentence of the rule turns on the customer's lease records, not on what the customer says: if any lease of that customer shows past due status, the customer cannot sign a new lease, whatever function the new lease would cover.

## Pairings (hypothetical households)

| Existing lease and its status | New lease asked for | Outcome under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace, active | ComfortLease Central Air | No shared function |
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace, pending installation | ComfortLease Heat Pump | Cannot be signed — both heat |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air, active | ComfortLease Central Air | Cannot be signed — the combination lease counts as cooling |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air, active | ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | Cannot be signed — the combination lease counts as heating |
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace, terminated | ComfortLease Gas Furnace | No shared function with a lease that still counts |
| ComfortLease Central Air, past due | ComfortLease Gas Furnace | Cannot be signed — the customer has a lease in past due status |
